name: doc-code-group
purpose: One or more code samples of the same thing in different languages or package managers, rendered on `CodeBlock` so the docs inherit its header, copy control and syntax surface. One sample renders a plain block; several render the joined tab strip.
useWhen: The same install command for npm, pnpm and yarn.
The same request in cURL, JavaScript and Python.
avoidWhen: For unrelated snippets — use one `CodeBlock` each.
For prose that differs per platform — use `DocTabs`.
related: CodeBlock` — the surface it renders on.
DocTabs` — alternatives that are prose, not code.
bestPractices: Label each sample with what differs (the language or the tool), not with "Example".
Keep the same order across a page.

props.name: samples
props.doc: The samples, in tab order: `{ label?, language?, fileName?, code }`. One renders a plain block, several render a joined tab strip; none renders nothing.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DocCodeGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/doc-code-group'
</script>

<template>
  <DocCodeGroup :samples="[{ language: 'bash', code: 'azion link --preset vue' }]" />
</template>

examples.name: Group
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DocCodeGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/doc-code-group'

  const samples = [
    { label: 'npm', language: 'bash', code: 'npm install @aziontech/webkit' },
    { label: 'pnpm', language: 'bash', code: 'pnpm add @aziontech/webkit' },
    { label: 'yarn', language: 'bash', code: 'yarn add @aziontech/webkit' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <DocCodeGroup :samples="samples" />
</template>
